items.title: ‘It feels like he’s quietly building a separate life’: My husband inherited $500,000, but he refuses to spend it on our home
items.description: “Our kitchen dates from 1999 and the oven only works if you hit the door a certain way.”

items.title: Funeral homes are finding new life hosting weddings and golf outings, as the traditional burial business dies out
items.description: “It’s not my funeral — it’s yours — so make it what you want,” one funeral-home operator says.

items.title: ‘I have no financial safety net’: I’m 66, rely on Social Security and have just $500 in savings. What hope do I have?
items.description: “Sometimes I wonder whether wealthier Americans should trade places with people like me.”

items.title: My 93-year-old father changed his will at the 11th hour, leaving my brother his entire $500,000 estate. Can I challenge it?
items.description: “My brother had no job and needed a place to live.”

items.title: Corporate America’s profit numbers are just barely beating Wall Street’s expectations
items.description: S&P 500 companies’ earnings are mostly topping analysts’ estimates — but by the narrowest margin in roughly four years.

items.title: ‘We’re losing to cottage cheese’: The protein-maxxing craze is hurting cream-cheese sales
items.description: U.S. cottage-cheese sales have more than doubled from levels seen in 2021.

items.title: Stocks are moving in sync again for the first time in a while. There’s just one problem.
items.description: An increasingly divided U.S. equity market is enjoying a rare moment of unity. Unfortunately, it has coincided with the biggest selloff in more than a year.

items.title: This market signal called the tech selloff. Now it’s sending another warning.
items.description: Correlations between individual stocks recently hit a record low, and a reversion to the mean may not be a good thing for the market.

items.title: This retired professor has reinvented himself — as a Taylor Swift scholar
items.description: His niece convinced him to spend his retirement analyzing Taylor Swift lyrics. Now he’s a successful podcaster at 72.

items.title: Second-guessing my adviser: Is an annuity the right move in this market?
items.description: “I haven’t committed to the strategy yet and would appreciate some independent perspectives.”
